aggregation: per-utterance mean and median; deterministic 5000-draw bootstrap of the median, resampled within speaker; interval describes variation within this fixed cohort, not population uncertainty
cohort: official VoiceBank+DEMAND test split; all 824 paired utterances

metrics.si_sdr_improvement_db: primary: zero-mean scale-invariant SDR(output) minus SI-SDR(noisy input)

scored_interval: complete aligned utterance; no crop, VAD, loudness normalization, or silence trimming
